name: Caturix
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: name may mean king of battle
an obscure deity of central Europe

text: Caturix is a Continental Celtic god. Inscriptions to this obscure deity appear across central Europe. His name may mean 'king of battle'. The occupying Romans identified Caturix with their war god Mars. The records describe Caturix as an obscure figure.

okr.objective: Caturix is an obscure Continental Celtic war god later tied to Mars.
